title: Tooling: exact Clifford state reuse with independent controls (no new kappa)
body:
The retained Clifford `monomial()` evaluator computes the same input state twice. This adds an opt-in, source-bound replay that reuses the saved `(vec, den)` in the final equality. The sole generated compiler edit removes six bytes; all support, denominator, tableau and absolute-phase assertions remain. Frozen construction sources and the default selected verifier are unchanged. This is verification tooling, with no new κ.

Validation passed the full identical U8 word (2,949 directed edges and 224 endpoint adapters) in three alternating baseline/candidate pairs, with identical canonical recipe bytes. Baseline seconds: 152.5922, 112.3706, 137.0704; candidate: 97.2235, 83.8536, 84.9869. The median ratio was 1.6128 and the timing ranges were disjoint. Some early runs shared the host with another allocated research job; these are observed phase-step timings, not quiet-host, default-verifier or multiplication-runtime measurements.

The separately implemented Gaussian-rational oracle passed 107 circuits, all 552 basis columns, 14,288 matrix entries and input immutability, with six mathematical fault rejections and six positive guard-reachability cases. Nine actual driver controls passed, including assertion/source/input guards and a real phase-child timeout. A relocated minimal source closure passed controls, probe and a fresh complete pair. Independent source and saved-artifact reviews passed; the final source archive was byte-audited, with unchanged executable/input bytes, but was not itself rerun.

Reproduce from the checkout with Python >=3.11 and a new external work directory:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/clifford-state-reuse/verify.py --work /tmp/clifford-state-reuse-fresh --rounds 3 --hard-seconds 3600
```

Expected: `PASS_EXACT_SOURCE_BOUND_PHASE_REUSE`. Source base: 8bddbee377e2f3ce1f1247196c4b290d55767d20; public head: 9c4c5d62825c795148a2d2b9062788160063d0cb; tree: 889538b580043226da7ff5783fbf89426a28927b. Only 18 files in one research directory are added. Whitespace and focused source/input/portability checks passed; full `make verify` and cold selected construction replay were not rerun.

Credit icekylinx and retained PR531/552/558, JeremyKothe's PR869/870, and Charles Bethin's PR662 gate tables. The final overlap refresh also credits adjacent #1029 (ff4d7b9ac97a584275fe0653f226f4ce2ffc6086, sparse amplitude support) and #1041 (9576c644a4cafd2cfac309689a19342451702f81, parallel phase scheduling/optional PR662). This contribution isolates saved monomial-state reuse and independently tests its exact semantics; it does not combine their implementations or timings or claim first priority. Current main abdc6a7002abdbcd9e21bfc5e1a795784deacfdf still selects #942; no selected-frontier edit.

All-size/compiler, global composition, hosting, physical admission, precision/tape, analytic transfer and bit H1–H5 obligations remain inherited. Apache-2.0; substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including independent implementation/review. No independent human review is claimed. Public receipts are labeled portable derivatives retaining hashes of private originals. Sprint seed88, verification engineering.
